title: On the Track
editorialSummary: Track and field events grouped by movement type. False trail: Discus and Hammer both involve circular throwing motion, and Long Jump and Triple Jump both involve runway approach — but the groups are throwing implements, jump types, sprint distances, and distance running. Players must know the exact event category.

meta.gptRationale: Track-and-field event groupings are highly familiar and internally clean, with very little abstraction or misleading overlap.
